about:
Custom Cable Solutions, Inc. (CCSI) operates from a 51,000-square-foot facility in Salisbury, Maryland, near the Baltimore-Washington defense corridor. The company has established itself as a recognized name in military and aerospace electronics, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

CCSI's core business is engineered cable assembly solutions. The ISO 9001:2015, AS9100D, and IQNET certified facility houses over 100 certified assembly technicians, mechanical and electrical engineers, quality and testing technicians, and interconnect specialists. Capabilities span build-to-print assembly, production technical support, reverse engineering, ISO-based quality programs with testing, and turnkey electromechanical systems planning and assembly. The company sources only factory-new components from U.S.-based manufacturers or authorized distributors and provides full material traceability to meet FAA and customer requirements.

The company serves aerospace and military contractors, aircraft manufacturers, and medical diagnostic equipment leaders. Its build-to-print programs support a range of defense and commercial aerospace applications, as well as medical device manufacturers requiring documented traceability.

CCSI emphasizes creative, cost-effective solutions for complex interconnect challenges, backed by a customer-focused team and a quality system aligned with aerospace and defense standards.
